Acronym Generator

Turn any phrase into an acronym instantly — first letters, with options to skip small words, add periods and force uppercase.

PhraseAcronym
Type a phrase above to generate its acronym.

Everything runs locally in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Type one phrase per line (e.g. North Atlantic Treaty Organization).
  2. Toggle options: skip small words like "of" and "the", add periods, force uppercase.
  3. Copy any acronym from the results table with one click.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between an acronym and an initialism?

An acronym is pronounced as a word (NASA); an initialism is spoken letter by letter (FBI). This tool builds the letter sequence for both.

Which words get skipped?

When enabled, small filler words are skipped: a, an, the, of, and, or, in, on, at, to, for, with, by, from, as, is, are.

Can I process many phrases at once?

Yes — put one phrase per line and every line gets its own acronym in the results table.
